sam: Heads up 1: after packaging reranker-v3 int8 we saw ndcg mostly unchanged but MRR drops ~5% on queries containing version tokens / urls. filing here to capture triage.

nora: slice? dataset?

sam: slice = regex match for versions or urls (e.g., v2, v2.1, https://). dataset = prod_holdout_feb2026.jsonl. float -> quant numbers: ndcg@10 0.700 -> 0.697, mrr@10 0.483 -> 0.459.

anya: did tokenizer binary change or any preproc flags in packaging? quant shouldn't change tokenization itself.

sam: double-checked container tag. tokenizer version same, but packaging enabled a micro-opt flag `preproc.normalize_urls=true` in the quant bundle (float runs used false). examples show different token splits:
- qid 4102 float tokens: ["v","2",".","1"] quant tokens: ["v2",".1"]
- qid 4120 float tokens: ["http","s","://","example",".","com","/","docs"] quant tokens: ["https://example.com/docs#v2"]

nora: that explains it. change is input-side. Top1 sensitive to token boundaries -> MRR drop. immediate action: re-run quant eval with normalize_urls=false to isolate model impact and revert packaging flag.

sam: job queued 5370012346 (quant eval with normalize_urls=false). eval-bot: job submitted.

eval-bot: Job submitted: 5370012346. Logs will appear under /runs/5370012346/*.

anya: longer-term: add explicit tokenizer manifest to model bundles (tokenizer_hash + preproc_flags) and surface in model catalog UI. add preflight lint to fail packaging if preproc flags differ from float baseline. also add a 2k query prime set for url/version patterns to quant smoke checks with an MRR threshold.

nora: I'll open the PR for the packaging lint and catalog manifest. also add the prime set to nightly smoke.

sam: will post follow-ups after job completes. keeping this thread for notes. :thumbsup:
